findings.title: Declare return types on exported functions
findings.message: The exported function `findAvailableWindows` is missing an explicit return type annotation. Add `: TimeSlot[]` to ensure the return type is declared as part of the function contract.

claims.claim: The exported function `findAvailableWindows` is missing an explicit return type annotation.
claims.reason: The citation shows the function signature with `: TimeSlot[]` explicitly declared as the return type. The diff also confirms that the function in the updated code (line 18 in the new version) includes the return type annotation `: TimeSlot[]`. Therefore, the function does have an explicit return type annotation.

claims.claim: Adding `: TimeSlot[]` to the function ensures the return type is declared as part of the function contract.
claims.reason: The rule document states that explicit return types are a contract that prevent internal refactors from silently widening the public type. The citation and diff both show that `: TimeSlot[]` is already present in the function signature. The claim about adding this annotation is accurate in principle (it does ensure the return type is declared), but it is not applicable here since the annotation already exists.
